name: roof ventilation unit
description: A large metal box and accompanying fan, built to circulate air within a building.  If you destroy it, you could gain access to the large ventilation shaft below.

variants.description: A hefty and expensive-looking golden dish engraved with concentric circuitry.  You felt the urge to rip it from a supercomputer.
A hefty and expensive looking silver dish, any light that hits it is reflected in a dazzling display of colors. A wonder of technology that will never be replicated again.
